# TL;DR

The application loads configuration from a **dotenv** file so secrets never reach source control.

## 1. Create your `.env`

```bash
cd ~/GitHub/AiTutor
cp .env.example .env
```

```bash
cd ~/GitHub/AiTutor
cp .env.example .env
```

## 2. Fill Required Keys

| Key | Description | Where to Find / What to Use |
|-----|-------------|---------------|
| `PG_PORT` | Port for local/Docker Postgres | `5432` (Local) or `5433` (Docker) |
| `PG_PASS` | Password for local/Docker Postgres | Notion → Secrets OR Use your own |
| `OPENAI_URL` | Base URL for OpenAI API | Notion → Secrets |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | API Key for Dev | Notion → Secrets |
| `SENDGRID_API_KEY` | For sending emails | Notion → Secrets |
| `SONARQUBE_API_KEY` | For Code quality checks | Notion → Secrets |


Open `.env` in your editor:

```bash
code .env
```

Any value left blank will cause the app to fail fast with a descriptive error.

## 3. Reloading Changes

Values are read **at application startup**. Restart the dev server after edits.
